notes.title: As Dusk Falls, one year on...
notes.content:
We can't quite believe it but today marks 1 year since the release of our debut title As Dusk Falls!

It’s been a journey, and we’ve loved every second of it! From its inception nearly a decade ago through development and launch, until today - here’s a trip down memory lane from when it all started back in 2016…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315155/c827caff3f41238693ad84c2ed3a079dc4b42b52.png[/img]

Over 45 people (and one very special dog!) joined us and brought a wealth of experience - from games, TV & film, and even the space program - to make As Dusk Falls a reality!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315155/563785c8c69829a9bf35b62a25a97e3f6f1aab22.png[/img]

1200 pages of script, 15000 hand-painted frames and 40+ major crossroads later, As Dusk Falls launched exactly one year ago!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315155/1dd27f5953ef81fed8d057f8870d17ec385813da.png[/img]

Mindblowingly, since then we’ve been nominated for 36 Awards & have humbly taken 'home' 6 - including The Game Awards, MCV/Develop and Indie Pearls! Our deepest thanks to everyone who played, nominated and supported us over the last year! We’re still pinching ourselves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315155/69328e3286d6b981b65999441e0c9ad4f1302b4d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315155/f682e5f7d1ab15432634aa1f8f9f71694eac9bca.png[/img]

Wow… what a year! 
Thank you for playing As Dusk Falls and spending time with the characters in Two Rock!
We’ve poured our heart and soul into our first title and we’re forever grateful!

~ INTERIOR/NIGHT

notes.title: As Dusk Falls receives BAFTA nomination & wins two MCV Awards!
notes.content:
[h3][b]It’s been a crazy start to 2023 for us here at INTERIOR/NIGHT - so we thought we’d stop by and tell you all about it![/b][/h3]

Firstly, we wanted to start off with a big THANK YOU to all of you who spent time with As Dusk Falls, and not only played but also shared its captivating story with your loved ones, friends, and communities. Your support means the world to us, and we thank you for taking the time to share your gaming experiences by leaving a review on Steam. We’ve read each and every one of the 1600+ reviews - so thank you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315155/04d799ffa1275d7caf00dc2466e0cbe5a6b767d0.png[/img]

For game development studios, the beginning of the year usually signifies the onset of Awards season; a time to recognise and celebrate the best in games - and what an exciting and humbling few months it’s been for us!

2023 started with a very exciting win at the Indie Pearls Awards, where As Dusk Falls received the Social Impact award - a win that set the tone for a remarkable few months that followed!

We were also proud to receive a nomination for Social Impact at GDC Awards, which saw the team touching down in vibrant San Francisco! We didn’t win but the experience was nothing short of unforgettable. We had the pleasure of connecting with friends old and new and excitingly [url=https://twitter.com/KahliefAdams/status/1638338022369562624?s=20]received our The Spawnies[/url] statuette in person from our dear friend Kahleef Adams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315155/f6a9e18f93846b1d8f506f53f3dfaee254d0fbe7.jpg[/img]

Our awards shelf is looking pretty great - as we also received our The Games Awards statuette in the flesh. Displaying alongside our Indie Pearls and the cherished Spawnie, we couldn’t help but capture the moment on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@int_night?lang=en]TikTok[/url] - which you totally should check out and make sure you join the fun!

[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@int_night?lang=en][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315155/e945e4004862755ba6c4dc7d5e34fcb28da2aa21.png[/img][/url]

Just when we thought the year couldn’t get any better, we received news that positively floored us: As Dusk Falls had been nominated for a BAFTA Games award! We had a brilliant time showcasing As Dusk Falls alongside the rest of the brilliant nominees' cohort - topped off with a surprise visit by As Dusk Falls’ Shannon Liz Perry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315155/736d6ab0e33d92571df342c6e73529b2ef6a11c4.png[/img]

The BAFTA ceremony evening was truly unforgettable - a true celebration of talent and creativity! It was an honour to be nominated alongside an exceptional selection of winners and nominees! And if you’re curious how the evening went, we’ve got you > [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@int_night/video/7217859787776675077?is_from_webapp=1&sender_device=pc&web_id=7214089766890079750]INTERIOR/NIGHT at BAFTA Games Awards[/url]

Last but definitely not least, last week As Dusk Falls was awarded not one but TWO awards at MCV/Develop Awards ceremony - Narrative Innovation of the Year and Accessibility Innovation of the Year! We’re still pinching ourselves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315155/b8e609c4ba95ac80c0db358946012c3958a09759.png[/img]

It’s been a surreal year for As Dusk Falls and us here at INTERIOR/NIGHT so THANK YOU - we are incredibly bowled over by all the support and love for our first game 💛

~ INTERIOR/NIGHT

notes.title: Nominate As Dusk Falls for the Outstanding Story-Rich Game category
notes.content:
It’s been a year of many ‘firsts’ for us - the release of our first title as a studio, our first sale, our first award nomination… and hopefully our first Steam Awards! 

As Dusk Falls is a branching narrative experience  - a tense and uncompromising story of family, betrayal and sacrifice that puts your moral compass to the test. 

We think As Dusk Falls deserves to be recognised in the [b]Outstanding Story-Rich Game[/b] category - and we hope you do too! If you enjoyed your time in small-town Arizona, we’d be honoured if you voted for us in this year’s Steam Awards!

As always, thank you for playing & for all your support so far!

~ INTERIOR/NIGHT

notes.content:

We are excited for you all to experience As Dusk Falls and have fun with your long-distance friends!

notes.title: Welcome to Two Rock: About As Dusk Falls, Gameplay & Multiplayer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315155/f852559ae92329b98f23228d1cc3dce646ca9e4a.png[/img]

Not long now until we welcome you to Two Rock County - As Dusk Falls is coming out in just under 3 weeks! We are overwhelmed by your support and excitement for our first title and we cannot wait for you to experience As Dusk Falls on July 19th!

[h1][b]About As Dusk Falls[/b][/h1]

As Dusk Falls is an original interactive drama from INTERIOR/NIGHT that explores the entangled lives of two families across thirty years. Starting in 1998 with a robbery-gone-wrong in small town Arizona, the choices you make have a powerful impact on the characters’ lives in this uncompromising story of betrayal, sacrifice and resilience. Replay the story again and again to uncover vastly different outcomes for the characters and explore hidden nuances behind every decision. Will your characters survive unscathed? What kind of people will they ultimately become?

[previewyoutube=jsvMyH3Dqbs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]Gameplay[/b][/h1]

As the story unfolds, As Dusk Falls presents players with choices that will decide the fate of Two Rock’s characters. Throughout the playthrough, they can make choices for the characters - what they will say or do - even the seemingly trivial decisions can have a major impact on the outcome of the story.

These decisions are shown as multiple responses which players choose using their game controller, keyboard/mouse, or even their mobile phone. 

As Dusk Falls also asks you to complete specific quick actions during tense moments like pressing a specific key or button, or swiping a controller in a certain direction.

[h1][b]Multiplayer[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42315155/f37b7517b20ead3385bf03458d245a4294bd9ed5.gif[/img]

In As Dusk Falls, every player has a voice and influence on how the story unfolds. Up to 8 players help drive the narrative cooperatively (or antagonistically) as they journey through the story. 

Up to 4 players can play together on the same screen by connecting additional controllers, and 8 players can play on the same screen using a combination of controllers and smartphones.

[i]Please note that each player will need their own copy of the game on Steam, Windows PC or Xbox console (including Game Pass) to enjoy online multiplayer.[/i]

[h1][b]About INTERIOR/NIGHT[/b][/h1]

INTERIOR/NIGHT is an independent game studio headed by Caroline Marchal, former lead game designer for Heavy Rain and Beyond: Two Souls.

The studio’s lean and diverse team is comprised of a mix of award-winning industry veterans and emerging talent, whose focus is on making original interactive stories that sit at the crossroads of prestige television and video games. By building experiences that explore universal themes such as love, loss, family, identity, sacrifice, and resilience, our games are designed to appeal to a broad audience who want to engage emotionally and learn more about themselves in the process.

Thank you all for your support so far! We can’t wait for you to experience As Dusk Falls on July 19th!

~ INTERIOR/NIGHT
